links.outcome: Participant-level diagnostic accuracy of AI referral classification vs masked ophthalmic examination reference standard
links.effect: Sensitivity 92.8% (95% CI 90.4%–94.7%), specificity 90.6% (88.8%–92.3%), PPV 84.4%, NPV 95.9%, accuracy 91.4%; 105 false positives, 44 false negatives among 1,732 participants.
links.quote: Sensitivity was 92.8% (95% CI 90.4%–94.7%), specificity 90.6% (88.8%–92.3%), positive predictive value 84.4% (81.4%–87.0%), negative predictive value 95.9% (94.5%–97.0%), and overall accuracy 91.4% (90.0%–92.7%).

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic accuracy and implementation study evaluating AI-assisted retinal screening in community primary healthcare centers.
